batch_notes: All 18 claims are originality conditions on looks, poses, staging or names. 17 are MISFILED as Orb's originality direction (vision.md:353; CLAUDE.md). One, AC-100, is CONFIRMED-MINOR S4 because a final form that copies a famous character's combination of features is real legal exposure. None is a release blocker today: the matching features are unbuilt or already conform.

The records lag behind the work in the same way across the slice. At least nine rows say Open where primary evidence shows the condition met or superseded: RL-035, RL-038, RL-044, RL-045, RL-051, RL-057, RL-061, RL-069, and the floor half of RL-076. The P0 gate flag line, review-log.md:279, is unchanged since 2026-09-29.

Corrections to the inventory: the P0 open list is review-log.md:279, not :270 (AC-102, AC-104). AC-110's protocol is written out at agency-pass-screen.md:43-48. AC-117's tick floor is in data and enforced.
What players see at the /play/ pin: capsule-rig fighters coloured from data, levitating rocks on, hexagonal mines, and the zip tick floor of 4. All of these conform to the conditions.

Outside this slice: 223 committed character concept SVGs are public (art/concepts: closeups, faces, refine, anti-hero, marked-aura, blank, directions, turnaround and others), including all nine close-up rounds and round 8, which Legal flagged. These are worth checking against Orb's 2026-10-06 rule that no WIP character art goes public (quoted in art/concepts/forms/gen-hero.mjs:3). docs/legal/tropes-and-folklore.md section 4 also writes franchise terms into a public committed file, as analysis.

External: the eCFR link redirected to an unblock page, so I used Cornell LII's text of 17 USC 102(b) and 37 CFR 202.1(a). I did not research trademark law for the form-name prefixes or for the 'Blow for Blow' label.
Not done: I rendered no SVG or frame (no browsers), so judgements about concept art rest on the docs and the data.
